content_sections.heading: Goa Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Notification Out
content_sections.text: The Office of the Director General of Police, Goa, has issued Notification No. 1 of 2026 for the absorption of 52 eligible Home Guard volunteers into Police Constable posts. The recruitment is conducted under the existing Recruitment Rules and is specifically intended for Home Guard volunteers who meet the prescribed service requirements. Applicants must possess the required educational qualification, knowledge of Konkani and a minimum of 18 years of Home Guard service as of 23 November 2026. The official notification also specifies the application submission location, seniority-based absorption process and mandatory basic training after appointment. Interested candidates should read the notification carefully before submitting their applications. Goa Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Notification

content_sections.heading: Goa Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The Goa Police has announced the application submission date for Home Guard volunteers seeking absorption into Police Constable posts. The notification was issued on 20 November 2026, and completed application forms must be submitted on 23 November 2026. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed service requirements by the specified cut-off date. Important: The notification specifically directs candidates to submit completed applications on 23 November 2026. No separate application submission window or submission time is specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Goa Police Constable Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 52 Goa Police Constable vacancies have been announced for absorption of eligible Home Guard volunteers. These vacancies will be filled according to the existing Recruitment Rules and the seniority of Home Guard volunteers who have completed at least 18 years of service. The notification does not provide a category-wise or gender-wise breakup of the vacancies. Both male and female Home Guard volunteers may be considered, provided they satisfy the eligibility requirements mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Am I Eligible for Goa Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Before applying for Goa Police Constable Recruitment 2026, candidates should confirm that they are existing Home Guard volunteers with the required educational qualification, service experience and language knowledge. This recruitment is not an open application process for fresh candidates. Only eligible Home Guard volunteers who have completed at least 18 years of service as of 23 November 2026 can be considered for absorption. No, freshers cannot apply for Goa Police Constable Recruitment 2026 under this notification. The 52 vacancies are specifically reserved for absorption of existing Home Guard volunteers who have completed at least 18 years of service as of 23 November 2026. Candidates without the required Home Guard service experience are not eligible for this absorption process. Important: This is a quick eligibility guide and does not confirm individual eligibility. Candidates should check the official notification and their Home Guard service records before applying.

content_sections.heading: Goa Police Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Goa Police Constable absorption recruitment must meet the educational qualification, minimum Home Guard service experience and language requirements specified in the notification. The eligibility conditions apply to both male and female candidates. Applicants must have passed the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination from a recognised board or possess an equivalent qualification. The notification does not prescribe a higher educational qualification for absorption into the Police Constable post. The most important eligibility condition for Goa Police Constable Recruitment 2026 is the completion of at least 18 years of service as a Home Guard volunteer. The service experience will be calculated as of 23 November 2026. Only candidates meeting this requirement can be considered for absorption under the announced quota. Candidates with less than 18 years of Home Guard volunteer service as of the specified date do not satisfy the service requirement under this notification. The Goa Police Constable Recruitment 2026 notification does not specify a separate minimum or maximum age limit for this Home Guard absorption process. It refers to the existing Recruitment Rules and requires candidates to have completed at least 18 years of Home Guard volunteer service. Applicants should refer to the applicable rules or contact the recruitment authority for any further age-related conditions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Goa Police Constable Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible Home Guard volunteers must submit their applications in the prescribed offline format. The notification does not provide an online application facility for this absorption process. Candidates can follow the instructions below. Visit the Office of the Home Guard and Civil Defence Organisation, Altinho, Panaji-Goa. Obtain the prescribed Goa Police Constable absorption application form free of cost. Read the eligibility conditions and application instructions carefully. Fill in the required personal and Home Guard service details correctly. Provide the educational qualification and other information requested in the prescribed form. Attach or present supporting documents as instructed by the recruiting office. Review the completed application form for errors or missing information. Submit the completed application form on 23 November 2026 at the Office of the Home Guard and Civil Defence Organisation, Altinho, Panaji-Goa. Retain a copy of the application or submission acknowledgement, if available. Note: The notification does not provide a detailed document checklist. Candidates should follow the instructions supplied with the prescribed application form rather than assuming specific attachments are mandatory.

content_sections.heading: Goa Police Constable Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The Goa Police Constable Selection Process 2026 under this notification is based on the seniority of eligible Home Guard volunteers who have completed at least 18 years of service. The notification specifies that the absorption quota will be filled according to seniority among candidates meeting the required service conditions. After absorption as Police Constables, selected Home Guard volunteers must undergo three months of basic training at the Police Training School and successfully pass the training. Eligibility Verification: Candidates must meet the educational qualification, 18-year Home Guard service and language requirements. Seniority-Based Absorption: The absorption quota will be filled according to seniority among eligible Home Guard volunteers. Basic Training: Absorbed Police Constables must undergo three months of basic training at the Police Training School. Training Qualification: Candidates must successfully pass the prescribed basic training. The notification does not announce a separate competitive written examination, physical efficiency test or interview schedule for this absorption recruitment. Candidates should follow further instructions issued by the Goa Police.

content_sections.heading: Goa Police Constable Training 2026
content_sections.text: Home Guard volunteers absorbed as Police Constables under Goa Police Recruitment 2026 will be required to undergo three months of basic training at the Police Training School. Successful completion of this training is mandatory according to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Goa Police Constable Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The Goa Police Constable Recruitment 2026 notification does not specify the salary, basic pay or pay scale applicable to the 52 absorption vacancies. Candidates should refer to the existing Goa Police Recruitment Rules and applicable Government of Goa pay provisions for the prescribed Police Constable salary and allowances.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions for Goa Police Home Guard Applicants
content_sections.text: Candidates seeking absorption as Police Constables should carefully check the requirements mentioned in Notification No. 1 of 2026. The recruitment is restricted to eligible Home Guard volunteers and is not a general Police Constable recruitment drive. Only eligible Home Guard volunteers can apply for the 52 absorption vacancies. Candidates must have completed at least 18 years of Home Guard service as of 23 November 2026. Passing the Secondary School Certificate examination or an equivalent qualification is essential. Knowledge of Konkani is mandatory, while knowledge of Marathi is desirable. The prescribed application form is available free of cost at the designated office in Altinho, Panaji-Goa. Completed applications must be submitted on 23 November 2026. The absorption quota will be filled according to seniority among eligible Home Guard volunteers. After absorption, candidates must undergo and pass three months of basic training at the Police Training School.
